{{Top|leg|canon=Signal eradicator}}
{{Otheruses|Eradicator}}
The '''eradicator''' program was a communications scrambler installed in the [[High Council Tower/Legends|four]] [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|council]] [[Tower of Reconciliation/Legends|spires]] [[Reassignment Council Tower/Legends|of]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It helped in preventing transmissions going in and out of the Temple from interception. It also kept the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] from being hacked.
